name: type: feat
description: A new capability or a change in behaviour.

name: type: fix
description: Something is broken and must behave the way it is documented.

name: type: refactor
description: Structure changes; behaviour does not.

name: type: test
description: Coverage or test harness work with no behaviour change.

name: type: docs
description: Documentation only.

name: type: chore
description: Tooling, CI, dependencies, static analysis configuration.

name: type: spike
description: Time-boxed investigation. The deliverable is a written decision, not code.

name: area: bootstrap
description: basic-scaffold.php, the plugin factory and the BasicScaffoldPlugin composition root.

name: area: infrastructure
description: src/Infrastructure: services, injector, views, autoloader. What generated plugins build on.

name: area: sample
description: src/SampleSubsystem and views/: example code a generated plugin replaces.

name: area: tests
description: tests/php: unit and integration suites, fixtures.

name: area: tooling
description: composer.json, PHPCS, PHPStan, Psalm and Rector configuration.

name: area: ci
description: GitHub Actions workflows, issue/PR templates, label sync.

name: area: docs
description: README, AGENTS.md, docs/ and inline documentation meant for plugin authors.

name: priority: p0
description: Drop everything: a security hole or a scaffold that does not boot.

name: priority: p1
description: Next up.

name: priority: p2
description: Wanted, not scheduled.

name: priority: p3
description: Someday. Needs a driving use case before it starts.

name: needs: decision
description: Blocked on a maintainer ruling, not on code. State the question and options.

name: needs: design
description: Blocked on an API or structural design answer the code cannot settle.

name: needs: repro
description: Blocked on a reproduction.

name: needs: human
description: Waiting on an action only a human can perform. State the action in the issue.

name: needs: use-case
description: Deliberately parked until something real drives it.

name: epic
description: A tracking issue. The work lives in its sub-issues; never coded directly.

name: agent-ready
description: Context and acceptance criteria are complete enough for an agent to take this unattended.

name: blocked
description: Waiting on another issue. Name it on a 'Blocked by #N' line in the body.

name: breaking
description: Changes an interface or convention generated plugins rely on. Needs a ruling before code.

name: security
description: Escaping, sanitization, capabilities, nonces, or anything exploitable.

name: good first issue
description: Small, well-bounded, and does not need the whole architecture in your head.

name: help wanted
description: The maintainer would like someone else to take this.

name: question
description: A question rather than a work item.

name: duplicate
description: Already tracked somewhere else. Link it and close.

name: wontfix
description: A deliberate no. The reason belongs in a closing comment.
